name: to_int_unchecked
declaration: unsafe fn to_int_unchecked < Int > (self) -> Int where Self : FloatToInt < Int > ,
rules: The `f16` value passed as `self` to `to_int_unchecked` must not be `NaN`.
The `f16` value passed as `self` to `to_int_unchecked` must not be infinite.
The `f16` value passed as `self` to `to_int_unchecked`, after truncating its fractional part toward zero, must be representable in the return type `Int`.
